test: npm run prepare:test && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:free-download'
sandbox: fresh browser context; request the landing-linked extension ZIP and assert a valid ZIP response

test: npm run prepare:test && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:no-account-screen'
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /demo/?demo=1 and assert it is usable without a sign-in form

claim: The sample opens a truthful color-only status warning
test: npm run prepare:test && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:demo-warning'
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo/?demo=1; assert the real check-note dialog says no written label exists and never treats service names as status cues

claim: Sample data stays separate from real checks
where: landing privacy section, demo banner, privacy policy, README
test: npm run prepare:test && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:demo-isolation'
sandbox: fresh browser context; inspect localStorage after demo launch and assert only a demo: key exists

claim: Reset demo removes sample state and reopens the sample warning
test: npm run prepare:test && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:demo-reset'
sandbox: fresh browser context; preserve a non-demo sentinel, reset, and assert demo data is recreated while sentinel remains

claim: Starting for real discards sample state
test: npm run prepare:test && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:demo-exit'
sandbox: fresh browser context; enter demo, choose Start for real, and assert the demo: key is absent

claim: The demo requests files from this site only
test: npm run prepare:test && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:demo-first-party'
sandbox: fresh browser context; intercept HTTP(S) requests throughout the demo/reset flow and assert same-origin only

claim: The sample warning reloads offline after its first visit
test: npm run prepare:test && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:demo-offline'
sandbox: fresh browser context; visit /demo, wait for its service worker, reload once, set offline, then reload and assert the sample warning and privacy banner

claim: Signal Check uses only explicit status labels as text cues
test: npm run prepare:test && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:extension-check-notes'
sandbox: fresh packaged extension profile; check unlabeled dots beside service names and explicitly named Ready/Blocked dots; assert different truthful guidance

claim: The extension checks Deutan and Protan red-green views and a Tritan blue-sensitive view
test: npm run prepare:test && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:color-vision-views'
sandbox: fresh packaged extension profile; run each selectable view through the real popup against a representative visible-page signal pair and assert the named check-note result and saved model

claim: Visible-page checking does not request network resources
test: npm run prepare:test && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:extension-local-check'
sandbox: fresh packaged extension profile; open a same-origin visible-page fixture, run the real popup capture, screenshot analysis, and script injection, then assert the check-note result and zero HTTP(S) requests during the operation

claim: Visible-page checks still work while offline
test: npm run prepare:test && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:extension-offline'
sandbox: fresh packaged extension profile and a loaded sample page; set the browser context offline, run the real popup check, and assert the check notes open

claim: The selected view and last result stay in browser-local extension storage
test: npm run prepare:test && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:extension-local-storage'
sandbox: fresh packaged extension profile; select a view, complete a mocked visible-tab check, and inspect chrome.storage.local

claim: Clear last check removes the stored last result
test: npm run prepare:test && npm run test:e2e -- --grep '@claim:extension-clear'
sandbox: fresh packaged extension profile; complete a check, use Clear last check, and assert the cleared state
